stories.stat_label: wild tigers, up from about 3,200 in 2010
stories.headline: Wild tigers have bounced back by 70% since 2010
stories.summary: In 2010 only around 3,200 wild tigers were left. WWF's 2026 Living Planet Report says there are now roughly 5,700, after years of sustained conservation work.
stories.why: It shows protection works, even for a species that looked doomed.

stories.headline: A lost Hittite royal archive is giving up its secrets
stories.summary: Archaeologists recovered 131 clay tablets and fragments this season at Kayalıpınar, ancient Šamuḫa. They tell of an epidemic, a princess's funeral and generals begging the king for help.
stories.why: We can now hear people from 3,400 years ago in their own words.

stories.headline: Cuba now has 1.42 GW of solar power
stories.summary: Cuba has built 144 solar plants and expects to pass 1.5 GW by year's end. Renewables now make 21.4% of its electricity, and 646 solar pumps supply public water.
stories.why: Sunshine is helping an island keep its lights and taps on.

stories.headline: A Nordic diet is linked to a longer life
stories.summary: Using health data from over 64,000 Swedish adults, Danish researchers estimate that a healthy Nordic diet of berries, rye, root veg and fish was tied to a 4% lower risk of death over 24 years.
stories.why: Healthy eating can be local, familiar food, not just the Mediterranean kind.
